tasks.t: Plant ALL starting gold on Parsnips
tasks.d: Buy from Pierre's shop. Till soil and plant immediately. Harvest on Day 5 for your first profit.
Walk to the beach pier — he gives it free. Start fishing immediately. Day 2 fishing beats farming income.
The Mines entrance is northeast of town. Goal: floor 10+ by Day 7. Bring Fried Eggs for health.

tasks.t: Pick up ALL forage items daily
tasks.d: Daffodils, Dandelions, Leeks — free money AND bundle items. Walk every path before mining.
Organize loot immediately. Keep ore, seeds, and bundle items. Sorted inventory = faster daily flow.
Fortune Teller at 6 AM (plan mining days). Queen of Sauce Sunday/Wednesday (free recipes forever).

tasks.t: Collect 5 Copper Bars → Upgrade Watering Can
tasks.d: 2,000g + 5 Copper Bars at Clint. Waters 3 tiles per swing. Halves daily watering energy cost.
100g each. Buy as many as you can. Plant immediately after festival. They regrow every 4 days.
Iron Ore unlocks here. You need it for the Fiberglass Rod and watering can upgrade chain.
30 energy each. Stock 30–50 for mine trips. Best free energy food in Spring.
Lets you use Bait. 5 Bug Meat = 1 Bait. Catch fish 30% faster starting immediately.

tasks.t: Donate first of each mineral to Gunther
tasks.d: 60 total donations unlocks Rusty Key → Sewers → Krobus (Iridium Band for 500g!).
Main income driver now. Sell Gold/Iridium quality. Keep normal quality for bundles.
Gold Ore available here. Gold Bars needed for Quality Sprinklers and Kegs later.
Cindersap Forest, 9 AM. Talk to EVERY NPC for free friendship boosts. Dance if 4+ hearts.
Pick two villagers to befriend seriously. Forage items work as liked gifts for most villagers.
Blueberries (80g/seed from Pierre) should be your main Summer crop. Save gold now.
Best Summer crop — 3 berries every 4 days. Spend most of your gold on Blueberry seeds.

tasks.t: Buy Starfruit seeds from Sandy in Calico Desert
tasks.d: 200g/seed. Requires bus repair (Vault Bundle). High-reward investment.
30 Wood + 1 Copper Bar + 1 Iron Bar + 1 Oak Resin. Start turning Strawberry Wine now.
Start animal products. Chickens→Eggs→Mayo. Animals take time to level up, start early.
Beach, 9 AM. Add a Gold or Iridium quality item to the potluck soup for best outcome.
3 berries × many plants = large batches. Sell Gold quality, keep Silver for bundles.
Goal: beat the Shadow Lord at floor 120 before winter. Skull Key unlocks Skull Cavern.
More Kegs = more wine batches running simultaneously. Oak Resin from Tappers on Oak Trees.

tasks.t: Craft Lightning Rods if you have 99 Bat Wings
tasks.d: Place 6–8 around farm. Every thunderstorm creates a Battery Pack — needed for Iridium Sprinklers.
Beach at 10 PM. Just show up — cinematic event, no action needed. All NPCs present.

tasks.t: Plant Cranberries + Pumpkins on Fall Day 1
tasks.d: Cranberries: best Fall regrow (2 berries every 5 days). Pumpkins: Giant Crop + bundle + Abigail's gift.

tasks.t: Clear Summer crops the night before Fall 1
tasks.d: Summer crops die overnight. Clear field on Summer Day 27–28 so you're ready to plant Fall Day 1.

tasks.t: Finish Community Center Pantry bundles if possible
tasks.d: Spring + Summer + Fall + Quality crop bundles → Greenhouse. This is the biggest Y1 goal.
Pick every bush in town. 20 energy each — stock 50+ for winter mining energy.

tasks.t: Upgrade Axe to Steel (if not done)
tasks.d: Needed to access Secret Woods (6 Hardwood/day). Essential for Hardwood buildings.
9 items of different categories (Gold/Iridium quality). Win 1st place → 2,000 Star Tokens → Stardrop!
Shadow Lord boss. Get Skull Key for Skull Cavern access.
Navigate the haunted maze for Golden Pumpkin (2,500g / rare gift item).
Cranberry Wine or Pickles carry you through winter with no crop income.

tasks.t: Hit 8+ hearts with your future spouse
tasks.d: Start the marriage process in winter. Need 10 hearts → Bouquet → Mermaid Pendant.

tasks.t: Skull Cavern on HIGH LUCK days
tasks.d: Check Fortune Teller at 6 AM. Only go on very good or good luck days. Bring Bombs + Stairs + food.

tasks.t: Reach 60 Museum donations → Get Rusty Key
tasks.d: Krobus sells Iridium Band for 500g on Mondays — the best ring in the game at incredible value.
Deluxe Barn: 25,000g. Deluxe Coop: 20,000g. Big Barn: 12,000g. Queue Robin early.
Ice fishing contest. Use Iridium Rod + Bait for best catch. Win for Star Token prizes.
ALL 3 nights! Magic Boat sells Pearl and rare furniture. Submarine gives unique fish. Stock rotates nightly.
Give a universally loved gift to your assigned partner: Golden Pumpkin, Pearl, or Prismatic Shard.

tasks.t: Upgrade tools to Gold tier at Clint
tasks.d: Gold Pickaxe (mines faster), Gold Axe (chops faster), Gold Watering Can (waters 5 tiles).
Gift twice/week all winter. Hit 10 hearts → buy Bouquet from Pierre (200g) to start dating.
